description: This file defines a command handler class for processing submissions of GSIM applications within the Fineract project. It is annotated with Spring's @Service and a custom @CommandType annotation specifying the entity as 'GSIMACCOUNT' and action as 'CREATE'. The class implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the command processing to the SavingsApplicationProcessWritePlatformService, specifically invoking the submitGSIMApplication method.

classes.name: GSIMApplicationSubmittalCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class acting as a command handler for GSIM application submissions, delegating processing to the SavingsApplicationProcessWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command for submitting a GSIM application by delegating to the underlying service.
